---

## GOOG $341.41

### Strategy Selector
IV elevated (89th pctl) + RSI deeply oversold (20.1) + near 200-MA → **Cash-Secured Put** is the dominant strategy. LEAPS appealing on price but IV makes them expensive.

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟢 GOOD SETUP (4/4)
- ☑ IV Rank 89th pctl ≥ 40 (extremely elevated)
- ☑ Daily RSI 20.1 ≤ 40 (deeply oversold, textbook)
- ☑ Price within 2.9% of 200-MA ($331.80)
- ☑ Premium yield: $325 strike at 1.25% ≥ 1.0%

Best strikes (Sep 18 expiry, ~28 DTE):
| Strike | Premium | Yield | Effective Basis | OI |
|--------|---------|-------|-----------------|----|
| $330 | $5.59 | 1.69% | $324.41 | 21,340 |
| $325 | $4.07 | 1.25% | $320.93 | 8,331 |
| $320 | $2.89 | 0.90% | $317.11 | 3,854 |

**Recommendation:** $325 strike — below 200-day MA, 1.25% yield, effective basis $320.93 (20.6% below 52w high). Would happily own GOOG at $321.

### Covered Call — 🔴 SKIP (1-2/4)
RSI 20.1 — stock is deeply oversold. Selling calls here caps the likely bounce. Wait for RSI 60+.

### LEAPS — 🟡 MONITORING (Score: 3-4/6)
- ☑ Daily RSI ≤ 35 (20.1)
- ☐ Weekly RSI curling up (36.3, still declining)
- ☑ Price within 5% of 200-MA (2.9%)
- ☐ IV Rank below 30th (89.1% — LEAPS very expensive now)
- ☑ Liquid chain (good spreads, strong OI)
- ☑ Pullback ≥15% (15.5%)

Price action ideal but IV makes LEAPS expensive. Monitor — if IV normalizes in 2-3 weeks while price holds, could become actionable.
